verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not a cap-table or equity-management product, so a native exit-waterfall feature that honors share-class preferences and participation is outside its product category. Generic abilities like "run code" and "create files" are building blocks a user could use to construct such an analysis; they are not the capability itself and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
